response.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM per_transaction AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept), scored AS (SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - m.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS position FROM scored) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall_avg, above_kept_avg FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST, transref;
